facts.evidence: Net sales for the second quarter of fiscal 2026 were $47.9 billion, an increase of $2.6 billion from the second quarter of fiscal 2025. (growth given as the release's dollar increase rather than the 5.7%; both are stated in the release and neither is misstated)
Net earnings for the second quarter of fiscal 2026 were $4.8 billion, or $4.79 per diluted share. (prior-year $4.58 comparative omitted, but the figure, period and GAAP basis are correct)
Adjusted (non-GAAP) diluted earnings per share for the second quarter of fiscal 2026 were $4.92. (prior-year $4.68 comparative omitted)
Comparable sales for the second quarter of fiscal 2026 increased 1.7%, with U.S. comparable sales increasing 1.3%.

The company reaffirmed its fiscal 2026 guidance, which includes: Total sales growth of approximately 2.5% to 4.5% ... Diluted earnings-per-share growth of approximately flat to 4.0% from $14.23 in fiscal 2025

Comparable average ticket for the second quarter of fiscal 2026 increased 2.8% ... while comparable customer transactions decreased 1.0%. (both percentages correct for the quarter; the appended '$92.50' level is a separate error flagged in Part 2)
For the six months ended August 2, 2026, the company paid $4.643 billion in cash dividends (prior-year $4,574 million comparative omitted)
Monitor the impact of IEEPA tariff refunds, which are expected to partially offset unplanned fuel, energy, and other product input costs throughout the fiscal year.

claims.claim: Net sales for the second quarter of fiscal 2026 were $47.9 billion.
Second quarter fiscal 2026 net sales were an increase of $2.6 billion from the second quarter of fiscal 2025.
Comparable sales for the second quarter of fiscal 2026 increased 1.7%.
U.S. comparable sales increased 1.3% in the second quarter of fiscal 2026.
Net earnings for the second quarter of fiscal 2026 were $4.8 billion.
Diluted earnings per share for the second quarter of fiscal 2026 were $4.79.
Adjusted (non-GAAP) diluted earnings per share for the second quarter of fiscal 2026 were $4.92.
Management attributed the results to broad based demand as customers continued to engage in smaller projects.
Comparable average ticket for the second quarter of fiscal 2026 increased 2.8%.
Comparable average ticket increased to $92.50 in the second quarter of fiscal 2026.
claims.note: Conflates two metrics. The release reports comparable average ticket only as a percentage change (2.8%) and gives no dollar level for it; $92.50 is 'Average ticket,' a separate line that per footnote 1 excludes HD Supply and SRS.

claims.claim: Comparable customer transactions decreased 1.0% in the second quarter of fiscal 2026.
At the end of the second quarter the company operated 2,364 retail stores.
At the end of the second quarter the company operated over 1,340 SRS locations.
The company reaffirmed its fiscal 2026 guidance.
Fiscal 2026 guidance includes total sales growth of approximately 2.5% to 4.5%.
Fiscal 2026 guidance includes comparable sales growth of approximately flat to 2.0%.
Fiscal 2026 guidance includes gross margin of approximately 33.1%.
Fiscal 2026 guidance includes operating margin of approximately 12.4% to 12.6%.
Fiscal 2026 guidance includes adjusted (non-GAAP) operating margin of approximately 12.8% to 13.0%.
Fiscal 2026 guidance includes diluted earnings-per-share growth of approximately flat to 4.0% from $14.23 in fiscal 2025.
Fiscal 2026 guidance includes adjusted (non-GAAP) diluted earnings-per-share growth of approximately flat to 4.0% from $14.69 in fiscal 2025.
Fiscal 2026 guidance includes approximately 15 new stores.
Fiscal 2026 guidance includes capital expenditures of approximately 2.5% of total sales.
As of August 2, 2026, total assets were $109.384 billion.
As of August 2, 2026, total liabilities were $92.767 billion.
Cash and cash equivalents at the end of the second quarter were $2.085 billion.
For the six months ended August 2, 2026, the company paid $4.643 billion in cash dividends.
For the six months ended August 2, 2026, the company spent $1.724 billion on capital expenditures.
IEEPA tariff refunds are expected to partially offset unplanned fuel, energy, and other product input costs throughout the fiscal year.
SRS and GMS are completed or pending acquisitions whose anticipated benefits the company may recognize.
Comparable customer transactions decreased 1.2% for the six months ended August 2, 2026.
